overall_reason: A stock SaaS skeleton end to end (dashboard-mock hero, featured-on marquee, numbered problem cards, solution cards, icon-tile feature grid, stat band, values, security cards, FAQ, CTA band, link-farm footer) with an orange gradient-glow hero and a tagline any HR tool could carry; the specific security detail lower down does not rescue the default skeleton.

findings.evidence: Failed T-STOCK-ORDER: hero with fake product dashboard mock -> video -> 'Featured on' logo marquee -> 1-2-3 problem cards -> 3 solution cards -> 6 equal feature cards -> 10 icon-tile 'Enterprise-grade by default' cards -> stat band (27 / 99.9% / Free) -> two-path cards -> values -> 6 security cards -> FAQ accordion -> CTA band -> multi-column link-farm footer. 10+ stock sections in stock order.
findings.before: Default SaaS landing sequence with every section in equal-card form
findings.after: Cut to the sections only this product needs (e.g. one real walkthrough of a leave request from apply to approval) and let one section carry the page instead of fourteen equal ones
findings.why: Specific words on a default skeleton still read as a default page; 7+ stock sections caps the read at generated.

findings.evidence: Failed T-RIVAL-NAME and T-MIRROR: h1 "Everything your team runs on, in one workspace" with orange accent words and the tagline "Connecting Teams. Empowering Work." stay true for any HR/ops suite (BambooHR, Rippling, Connecteam). Hero is a peach radial-glow card with a browser-chrome dashboard mock ('Good morning, Otto', 'Acme Studio').
findings.before: "Everything your team runs on, in one workspace" / "Connecting Teams. Empowering Work."
findings.after: A head naming the job only Consile claims (tasks plus attendance plus leave for 2-200 people) in concrete terms, e.g. [DATA NEEDED: the one workflow customers switch for]; drop the quoted slogan line
findings.why: The first screen does not belong to this business; the slogan is pure filler set in a quote rule as if it were a testimonial.

findings.evidence: Mock uses the default cast "Acme Studio" and "Good morning, Otto" with round sample numbers (18 tasks, 92%, 35 people); labelled 'PRODUCT PREVIEW · SAMPLE DATA'.
findings.after: A real screenshot of a seeded workspace with a plausible name, or [DATA NEEDED: real product screenshot]
findings.why: Acme and a placeholder first name are the default-agent cast; a hand-coded dashboard mock in a hero is a look-family tell the sweep only partly measures.

findings.where: 'Featured on' marquee, tile 02, and badges strip
findings.evidence: Social proof is a scrolling wall of launch-directory badges (SaaSHub, Product Hunt, Startup Fame, 'SaasHunt Top 1 Daily Winner', KittyLaunch, Launchstag, LaunchBuff, Boost Domain Rating, Sell With Boost, 'Made with Lovable') plus G2/Capterra tiles labelled "Peer reviews" and "Software marketplace" with no rating or review count shown.
findings.before: Marquee of 20+ directory badges repeated three times
findings.after: Show one verifiable proof (an actual G2 rating with count and link) or remove the strip; [DATA NEEDED: real customer or review count]
findings.why: Directory listings dressed as press/reviews inflate proof; a 'Peer reviews' tile with no reviews implies evidence that is not shown.

findings.where: 'Why teams struggle' and 'How Consile solves it' sections, tiles 02-03
findings.evidence: Problem cards numbered "1 Tool Overload / 2 Flying Blind / 3 Manual Busywork" under pill eyebrows 'The problem' / 'The solution', then three solution cards "One Platform, Zero Chaos", "Real-Time Team Pulse", "Workflows That Run Themselves".
findings.before: Problem/solution pill eyebrows with 1-2-3 numbered cards and Title Case slogan heads
findings.after: One paragraph naming the actual switch (spreadsheet leave tracker + Trello + Slack) and a screenshot of the replacement; drop the numbers and pill labels
findings.why: The problem-agitation-solution triad with numbered equal cards is a default agent structure; numbers imply a sequence that does not exist (SLP-002, SLP-001).

findings.evidence: Failed T-FRESH-READER: "Questions, answered", "Enterprise-grade by default", "Choose your way in", "What we believe" / values 'Better together', 'Speed is a feature', 'Built for the human at the desk' fit any site.
findings.before: "Questions, answered" / "What we believe" / "Speed is a feature"
findings.after: Heads that state a fact, e.g. "SSO, SCIM and audit streaming on every plan" (if true) in place of "Enterprise-grade by default"; delete the values list
findings.why: Generic heads are the lines a model writes when it has no brief.

findings.evidence: Image alt "Diverse team of collaborators working together around a shared workspace": a stock-style collaboration photo standing in for the company.
findings.after: [DATA NEEDED: photo of the actual team or a real customer workspace] or remove
findings.why: Stock people imply a team or customers the page does not show.

strengths: The enterprise and security copy is concrete and falsifiable: 'SAML 2.0 with metadata URL/XML', 'signed webhooks with retry & DLQ', 'TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest', 'RLS policies on every table'. Keep these specifics.
Hero sub-line names a real positioning (projects plus people in one tool, teams of 2-200).
not_investigated: No 00-contract.md: no brief overrides or brand facts available; orange accent treated as brand colour, not judged as a tell.
Hero motion orbs and marquee seen only as stills.
